_comment: dose-cite-v3 verdict fixtures, one named group per clause of the rule. Each case: a reply + a source set (a name from sources.json, or an inline array) -> the expected verdict fields. WITHHELD stands for lookup-guard.js WITHHELD_BANNER and a displayText of exactly NO_EVIDENCE for LOOKUP_NO_EVIDENCE_TEXT. "probe N" cases are the re-reviews' adversarial pairs (all withheld); "benign BN" cases are correctly cited sentences, kept where v3 fixed the normalisation and withheld (group over-withholding-residual) where the cost is the founder's. The canonical rule is src/triage/lookup-guard.js; the triage repo vendors it and asserts identity group by group.
